turns.content: A single-qubit channel flips the computational-basis state with probability p. Which two operations represent the no-flip and flip events, and what probability belongs to each?
Turn those two events into Kraus operators A_0 and A_1 in matrix form, using probability amplitudes as their scalar weights.
Verify the trace-preserving completeness relation A_0^dagger A_0+A_1^dagger A_1=I.
Apply the channel to a general one-qubit density matrix and show how the two branches are mixed.
Why do the scalar weights enter as square roots, and why can an overall phase on either Kraus operator leave the channel unchanged?
Report the two Kraus operators and the resulting map E(rho).
